Inlay op1 `Star` (female board): deepest cut 0.1575 in below the stock top, a flat floor at depth_mm 0.1575 in; V-bit floor ridges 0.0157 in along the rings and up to 0.0315 in at their corners where no clearing pass reaches.
Inlay op1 `Star` (male board): deepest cut 0.1969 in below the male board's top, the plug's start plane 0.1181 in below the male board's top and the surround's flat floor plug_depth_mm 0.0787 in below that; V-bit floor ridges 0.0079 in along the rings and up to 0.0157 in at their corners where no clearing pass reaches; clearing pass `t2` cuts the band's outer edge upright, its inward curves rounded to 0.0625 in; the cut-out frees the plug along the floor's outer edge, its centre 0.0625 in inside the band's edge and at least 0.2525 in out from the design, through the board to 0.0079 in below it.
